exposure: visibility of the caesarean scar niche
outcome: Placental location (high or low and anterior or posterior)
cohort: 122 women aged 18 to 41 years during pregnancy after one or more previous caesarean sections
finding: The number of previous caesarean deliveries and the presence of a caesarean scar niche were not associated with the incidence of low-lying placentas in the first trimester.
mod_finding: The number of previous caesarean deliveries has no effect on the incidence rate of low-lying placentas in the first trimester.
